Netanyahu and Eisenkot Meet on Israeli Government Formation

Benjamin Netanyahu and Benny Gantz met for four hours to discuss the formation of a new government in Israel. The meeting's specifics remain undisclosed, but reports suggest discussions revolved around the potential for Gantz's party to join the government. One report indicated Netanyahu would remain Prime Minister, questioning the viability of Gantz's strategy involving Arab parties.
